computation.relative_to_r5_1: Adds 40*N non-addition edit candidates to the existing 40*N+41 KEEP/INSERT candidates; encoder inference is unchanged and exact CTC scoring remains the dominant added work.

existing_vectorization_opportunities: Reuse one log-softmax posterior tensor for every hypothesis of the word.
Apply the minimum-step guard before batching so impossible targets never enter CTCLoss.
Batch alignable targets with the existing flattened-target CTCLoss adapter.
Order or group work by encoder and target length to limit padding.
Score KEEP only once and share it across all relation comparisons.
Retain only family maxima and deterministic argmax identities when full candidate exports are not required.

runtime_output_feasibility.nonaddition_winner_handling: Return NON_ADDITION; optionally retain KEEP/SUB/DELETE winner as research diagnostic only.

technical_cautions: Define safe empty DELETE target scoring for N=1.
Freeze within-family and cross-family tie rules before execution.
Apply R5-1A negative-infinity semantics to every family.
Do not interpret a zero_infinity=True zero loss for an impossible target.
Do not assume runtime latency until separately benchmarked without evaluation leakage.
